title: Cloudflare shares jump after forecast raise on higher AI-driven spending
excerpt: Cloudflare shares rose 16% before the bell on Friday after the cloud services firm raised its annual forecasts, ‌betting that growing enterprise spending on...
content_html:
Reuters

Fri, August 7, 2026 at 6:54 AM EDT 2 min read

Aug 7 (Reuters) - Cloudflare shares rose 16% before the bell on Friday after the cloud services firm raised its annual forecasts, ‌betting that growing enterprise spending on AI infrastructure would drive demand ‌for its networking and security products.

The results, reported after markets closed on Thursday, add to signs ​that higher AI adoption is boosting demand beyond chipmakers to companies providing the software and infrastructure used to build and run AI applications.

The earnings follow Amazon.com's strongest cloud growth in more than four years. Amazon company noted that ‌it won't have enough capacity ⁠to meet all demand this year.

Analysts at TD Cowen said that Cloudflare is "well-positioned to play a lead role as ⁠AI unfolds."

Cloudflare now expects full-year revenue of $2.86 billion to $2.87 billion, up from its prior expectation of $2.805 billion to $2.813 billion. It also lifted its adjusted earnings per share ​forecast ​to a range of $1.25 to $1.26 from its ​earlier estimate of $1.19 to $1.20.

The company ‌added about 2 million developers in the second quarter alone, surpassing the 1.5 million it added last year.

Analysts at Morgan Stanley said Cloudflare's Workers developer platform was its fastest-growing segment, amid a shift toward a usage-based model, expecting the company to exceed its outlook.

San Francisco-based Cloudflare's security business could also ‌benefit as companies look to protect AI-powered ​applications and workers from increasingly sophisticated cyber ​threats.

Shares of the company have ​gained over 44% so far this year, compared with a ‌near-77% rise in rival CrowdStrike and ​a 95% jump in ​Palo Alto Networks. The stock trades at over 190 times its forward price-to-earnings ratio, compared with over 145 for CrowdStrike, according to ​LSEG-compiled data.

The company "has multiple, ‌durable avenues to AI monetization over the long-to-medium term that warrants ​a premium valuation," RBC Capital Markets analysts noted.

(Reporting by Purvi Agarwal ​in Bengaluru; Editing by Joyjeet Das)

content_html_zh:
路透社

2026 年 8 月 7 日星期五，美国东部时间上午 6:54 阅读 2 分钟

8 月 7 日（路透社） - Cloudflare 股价在周五盘前上涨 16%，此前这家云服务公司提高了年度预测，押注企业在人工智能基础设施上的支出不断增长将推动对其网络和安全产品的需求。

周四市场收盘后公布的结果进一步表明，人工智能采用率的提高正在推动芯片制造商以外的公司以及提供用于构建和运行人工智能应用程序的软件和基础设施的公司的需求。

在此之前，亚马逊云业务实现了四年多来最强劲的增长。 亚马逊公司指出，今年将没有足够的产能来满足所有需求。

TD Cowen 的分析师表示，Cloudflare“处于有利位置，可以在人工智能的发展中发挥主导作用”。

Cloudflare 目前预计全年收入为 28.6 亿美元至 28.7 亿美元，高于之前预期的 28.05 亿美元至 28.13 亿美元。 该公司还将调整后每股收益预测从之前的 1.19 美元至 1.20 美元上调至 1.25 美元至 1.26 美元。

仅第二季度该公司就增加了约 200 万开发人员，超过了去年增加的 150 万。

摩根士丹利的分析师表示，随着向基于使用的模式转变，Cloudflare 的 Workers 开发者平台是其增长最快的部分，预计该公司的业绩将超出预期。

总部位于旧金山的 Cloudflare 的安全业务也可能受益，因为公司希望保护人工智能驱动的应用程序和员工免受日益复杂的网络威胁。

今年迄今为止，该公司股价已上涨超过 44%，而竞争对手 CrowdStrike 上涨了近 77%，Palo Alto Networks 上涨了 95%。 根据 LSEG 编制的数据，该股的市盈率超过其预期市盈率 190 倍，而 CrowdStrike 的市盈率超过 145 倍。

加拿大皇家银行资本市场分析师指出，该公司“在中长期内拥有多种持久的人工智能货币化途径，保证了溢价估值”。

（Purvi Agarwal 班加罗尔报道；Joyjeet Das 编辑）
